== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Lead says all six previews were later printed with black borders in Special Edition, but the card table gives [[Cloud City]] as the black-border printing for [[Boba Fett]].
=== Marginal cuts ===
* Lead: "CardGuide numbering: 10th product." (repeats "10th Star Wars CCG product").
* Card list intro repeated the lead ("white-bordered previews ... later printed with black borders in Special Edition ... became tournament-legal when this product was released"); cut to one line.
* Sources list removed. Encyclopedia 3.2 and Wookieepedia were already refs; Decipher cardlists and Complete Card List are now refs on the Card list. Not tied to any sentence, so moved here:
** [https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions] at Decipher.com (archive, 4 May 1999)
